title: Terrific game experience
text: Awesome experience learning about Barcelona while navigating from place to place and solving puzzles along the way.  It is completely off line which is great and you will have a live game master who meets you at each stop to give you information and provide the next clue.  Great way to spend a few hours!
author: tdanielr

title: Amazing activity
text:
The citygame was really fun to do! We dit it with our family and is was a great wat to explore the city.

The guidance of Desie was amazing! She was really kind and helpfull and told us a lot of facts about the city. 10/10 would do it again🫶🏻

title: Super experience
text:
Super experience!
We enjoyed the treasure hunt very much with our family group of 13 adults.  
It was challenging and fun. We are all very competitive and all enjoyed it, although the winners enjoyed it more ofcourse 😉.
Well organised, not too easy, we really had to do some thinking, and not too difficult,
Thank you!
author: kwintertje

title: Fun treasure hunt to discover even more about the Born
text: Very nice treasure hunt in the old Born neighborhood. A creative way to discover this lovely area of Barcelona, exploring its alleys and knowing more about history in a fun way.  I recommend whether you do not know the city or if you live in it. The guide was very knowledgeable and friendly.
author: AniS264

title: I am a puzzle-hater and I LOVED this tour!
text: I really loved the tour because we saw sooooo many new parts of Barcelona, a city I visited many times before. The tour guide was fun-loving, happy and mercifully helpful when we needed some help with the puzzle 😂
author: Galder-Noord
